sentences.text:
This Writ Petition is filed declaring the action of the respondents, more specifically, trying to demolish the house bearing D.No.4-117, Plot No.18, Sy.No.1B/2C, Basinikonda Village, Madanapalle Mandal, Chittoor District (Now Annamayya District) without paying full compensation to the petitioner.
2.

On 25.11.2025, the learned counsel for the respondents, on written instructions, has submitted that the compensation amount was fixed at Rs.6,40,988/- and the said amount was deposited in the petitioner's bank account, bearing No.75690100010338, on 30.10.2025.
The learned counsel for the petitioner sought time to obtain instructions regarding the said deposit.
The matter was accordingly adjourned.
3. Today, learned counsel for the petitioner has consented with regard to the deposit of the said amount.
However, he has raised a dispute regarding the extent of the property.
This Court is not inclined to entertain such a dispute, as the petitioner has an appropriate remedy available under the provisions of the Act.

4. Considering the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition as well as the consent given by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is disposed of, W.P. No.32538 OF 2025 Date of order:04.12.2025 granting liberty to the petitioner to redress his grievance before the appropriate authority, if so advised.
No costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
